items.desc: Supply and apply bituminous waterproofing materials for roofs and foundations of electrical rooms and pump-site rooms. Materials must be submitted for approval before execution. Work includes: -Apply 1 coat of primer. -Apply 2 coats of bituminous layer. -Install 2 layers of 4mm membrane with 10 cm overlaps. -Include skirting 30 cm all around.

Waterproofing of Water Tanks (internal and external) Scope of Work: Waterproofing of water tanks to prevent leakage and protect the concrete. Includes the following steps: External Waterproofing: Build a solid masonry wall (20×20×40 cm blocks) around the tank (from the outside). Apply 2 coats of bitumen (primer not needed since 2 coats are specified). Install 2 layers of 4mm bituminous membrane with 10 cm overlaps (Membrane). Apply a protective layer over the membrane to safeguard it during backfilling and other construction works. Internal Waterproofing (after concrete works): Prepare and clean the concrete surface thoroughly from dust and debris. Apply tank-grade epoxy internal waterproofing with 1 mm thickness. Ensure full coverage of all surfaces and corners. Notes: All materials must be submitted for approval before execution. Includes all ancillary works such as surface preparation, membrane protection, and quality assurance of application.

items.desc: Supply and apply bituminous waterproofing materials for roofs and foundations of electrical rooms and pump-site rooms. Materials must be submitted for approval before execution. Work includes: -Apply 1 coat of primer. -Apply 2 coats of bituminous layer. -Install 2 layers of 4mm membrane with 10 cm overlaps. -Include skirting 30 cm all around.

Waterproofing of Water Tanks (internal and external) Scope of Work: Waterproofing of water tanks to prevent leakage and protect the concrete. Includes the following steps: External Waterproofing: Build a solid masonry wall (20×20×40 cm blocks) around the tank (from the outside). Apply 2 coats of bitumen (primer not needed since 2 coats are specified). Install 2 layers of 4mm bituminous membrane with 10 cm overlaps (Membrane). Apply a protective layer over the membrane to safeguard it during backfilling and other construction works. Internal Waterproofing (after concrete works): Prepare and clean the concrete surface thoroughly from dust and debris. Apply tank-grade epoxy internal waterproofing with 1 mm thickness. Ensure full coverage of all surfaces and corners. Notes: All materials must be submitted for approval before execution. Includes all ancillary works such as surface preparation, membrane protection, and quality assurance of application.
